properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 15 at 9:58AM MDT until September 15 at 1:00PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
FFWGJT

The National Weather Service in Grand Junction has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
The Babylon burn scar in...
Central San Juan County in southeastern Utah...

* Until 100 PM MDT.

* At 958 AM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain over the Babylon Burn Scar. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly. Excessive rainfall over the burn scar
will result in debris flow. The debris flow can consist of rock,
mud, vegetation and other loose materials.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding in and around the Babylon Burn Scar.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of areas in and around the
Babylon Burn Scar.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of Central San Juan County.
properties.instruction:
This is a life threatening situation. Heavy rainfall will cause
extensive and severe flash flooding of creeks...streams...and ditches
in the Babylon Burn Scar. Severe debris flows can also be anticipated
across roads. Roads and driveways may be washed away in places. If
you encounter flood waters...climb to safety.

Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 1:00 PM MDT. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 1:00 PM MDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

properties.headline: Flood Watch issued September 15 at 10:58AM CDT until September 15 at 4:00PM CDT by NWS Des Moines IA
properties.description:
...The Flood Watch continues for the following rivers in Iowa...

East Nishnabotna River near Atlantic affecting Cass County.

* WHAT...Flooding is possible.

* WHERE...East Nishnabotna River near Atlantic, or from Troublesome
Creek near Atlantic to Indian Creek near Lewis.

* WHEN...Until this afternoon.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 9:00 AM CDT Tuesday the stage was 15.1 feet, and rising.
- Forecast...Rises on the river are possible over the next few
days. The river may reach flood stage.
- Flood stage is 19.0 feet.
properties.instruction:
If you are in the watch area, remain alert to possible flooding.

For the latest stream observations and forecasts refer to
weather.gov/desmoines/water.

River forecasts include observed precipitation plus forecast
precipitation over the next 24 hours.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WATCH REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL THIS AFTERNOON

properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 15 at 9:49AM MDT until September 15 at 12:45PM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
properties.description:
FFWGJT

The National Weather Service in Grand Junction has issued a

* Flash Flood Warning for...
Central San Juan County in southeastern Utah...

* Until 1245 PM MDT.

* At 949 AM MDT, Doppler radar indicated thunderstorms producing
heavy rain across the warned area. Flash flooding is ongoing or
expected to begin shortly.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Thunderstorms producing
flash flooding.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams,
urban areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

* Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Mainly rural areas of Central San Juan County.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Flooding is occurring or is imminent. It is important to know where
you are relative to streams, rivers, or creeks which can become life
threatening in heavy rains. Campers and hikers should avoid streams
or creeks.

Please report observed flooding to local emergency services or law
enforcement and request they pass this information to the National
Weather Service when you can do so safely.

Immediately climb to higher ground. Runoff concentrated through
narrow canyon walls can quickly become dangerous, life threatening
conditions.

properties.headline: Flood Warning issued September 15 at 11:52AM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
properties.description:
...The Flood Warning is extended for the following rivers in
Florida...

Horse Creek Near Arcadia at SR 72 affecting DeSoto County.

...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Florida...

Withlacoochee At US 41 Dunnellon affecting Levy, Marion and Citrus
Counties.

.Elevated water levels are expected along a few rivers across the
area over the next several days.

* WHAT...Minor flooding is forecast.

* WHERE...Horse Creek near Arcadia at SR 72.

* WHEN...From Thursday evening until further notice.

* IMPACTS...At 12.0 feet, The access road to Hidden Oak is
impassable.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 10:30 AM EDT Tuesday the stage was 9.5 feet.
- Bankfull stage is 12.0 feet.
- Forecast...The river is expected to rise above flood stage
Thursday evening and continue rising to 12.1 feet early Friday
morning. Additional rises are possible thereafter.
- Flood stage is 12.0 feet.
- Flood History...This crest compares to a previous crest of 12.1
feet on 09/30/2003.
- https://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Caution is urged when walking near riverbanks.

Additional information is available at www.weather.gov.

The next statement will be issued this evening at 1145 PM EDT.

NWSheadline: FLOOD WARNING NOW IN EFFECT FROM THURSDAY EVENING UNTIL FURTHER NOTICE
